name: ezrecord
description: Record, edit, caption, dub and post videos with ezRecord on your Mac: product demos Claude films for you, edits by transcript, shorts, dubbing and shoot plans.

server_url.title: ezRecord address
server_url.description: ezRecord's agent server on this Mac. Leave as is unless you changed its port in ezRecord.

passcode.title: ezRecord passcode
passcode.description: From ezRecord › Settings › Agents › Copy Passcode. ezRecord's tools only answer on this Mac, and only with this passcode.
